name: Force
body:
The ghoul can make the target wither visibly, robbing it of its lifeforce.

Requirement: Ghoul HD 17

Effect: The subject gains 1d2 negative levels. This touch of loss has no saving throw when it is inflicted, but after 24 hours, the subject can make a Fortitude saving throw to remove all negative levels it has received.
